verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਸਿਖਣਾ ਨਾਦੁ ਨ ਵੇਦ ਨ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: gur sikhee dhaa sikhanaa naadh na vedh na aakh vakhaanai|

en.bdb: The discipline of the discipleship of the Guru is ineffable for the Vedas and all the melodies.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਲਿਖਣਾ ਲਖ ਨ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਪਤਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਜਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: gur sikhee dhaa likhanaa lakh na chitr gupat likh jaanai|

en.bdb: Even Chitragupt, the writer of the accounts of the actions of the people, does not know how to write about the spirit of Sikh life.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਸਿਮਰਣੋ ਸੇਖ ਅਸੰਖ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: gursikhee dhaa simarano sekh asa(n)kh na rekh sin(j)aanai|

en.bdb: The glory of simaran, remembrance of the name of the Lord, cannot be known by myriad Seanags (thousand hooded mythical snake).

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਵਰਤਮਾਨੁ ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਪਛਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: gur sikhee dhaa varatamaan veeh ikeeh ula(n)gh pachhaanai|

en.bdb: The conduct of the Sikh spirit can be known only by going beyond the worldly phenomena.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਬੁਝਣਾ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਿਵ ਆਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: gursikhee dhaa bujhanaa giaan dhiaan a(n)dhar kiv aanai|

en.bdb: How can anybody understand the Sikh way of life or Gursikhi through learning and contemplation alone?

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: gur parasaadhee saadh sa(n)g sabadh surat hoi maan nimaanai|

en.bdb: By the grace of the Guru, in the holy congregation, the gursikh concentrating his consciousness in the Word sheds pride and becomes humble.
A rare one may enjoy the pleasure of loving devotion.
